_notes.source: Live plan pages read in Chrome on 2026-10-20: https://myfundedfutures.com/plans/builder, /rapid, /rapid-eod, /pro (every size), homepage banner, and help article 'Becoming an Affiliate with MyFundedFutures'. List prices unchanged.
_notes.pricing: standard = the plan's listed one-time price (crossed out). promo = 'Starting at' price with code CLUB (40% off any plan, banner 2026-10-20), now shown for every size. New customers can get 50% off their first evaluation instead (not applied here).
_notes.billing: All new evaluations bought on or after 25 August 2026 are a one-time payment with no renewal ('One-time purchase, nothing to cancel'). Older monthly subscriptions continue as 'legacy' subscriptions. No activation fee on any plan. Resets are sold separately (reset prices not read). New one-time accounts close after 7 calendar days without a trade (evaluation and sim funded).
_notes.builder_50k_add_on: Builder 50K is also sold with a smaller $1,500 max loss (floor $48,500) for $125 (40% off: $75). Everything else is the same. The table shows the default $2,000 version.
_notes.daily_loss: Builder: soft-pause daily loss limit ($600 / $1,000 / $1,750 / $2,500) - hitting it stops trading for the rest of the session but does not fail the account. Rapid, Rapid EOD and Pro: the firm states there is no daily loss limit (recorded as 'none').
_notes.drawdown: Builder, Rapid EOD and Pro use an end-of-day trailing max loss throughout. Rapid uses an end-of-day max loss in the evaluation and an intraday trailing max loss on the sim funded account. Max loss locks once it trails to $100 above the starting balance.
_notes.consistency: Builder: no consistency rule in the evaluation; 50% rule on payouts (best day max 50% of profit in each payout cycle). Rapid and Pro: 50% in the evaluation only. Rapid EOD: 30% in the evaluation only. Exceeding it does not fail the account - you trade more days. Pro One-Day add-on (limited time, 50K, $4,000 target) has no consistency rule; not listed separately.
_notes.max_contracts: Mini contracts allowed in the evaluation (micros = 10x). Pro sim funded accounts allow more (5 / 10 / 15 minis); Builder and Rapid live accounts allow fewer.
_notes.payout_caps: Builder: maximum per payout cycle ($1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500), up to 5 sim payouts, then eligible for a live account. Rapid EOD: help centre says no cap per payout cycle. Rapid: no cap stated. Pro: lifetime maximum of $100,000 payouts per user on sim funded, not a per-request cap, so left null. Payout timing: Builder 48 hours after first funded trade; Rapid and Rapid EOD daily; Pro 14 calendar days from first funded trade. Buffers must be cleared first (e.g. $2,100 on 50K).
_notes.profit_split: Rapid and Rapid EOD 90/10; Builder and Pro 80/20.
_notes.fee_refund: Site footer: 'Evaluation fees are non-refundable.' A full refund is only possible within 14 days if no trades were placed (not for crypto purchases). No refund after passing, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.platforms: Official help centre lists NinjaTrader, Tradovate, TradingView, Quantower, Volumetrica, DeepChart and ATAS. The homepage plan cards also mention Hyperprop (not listed here until its role is confirmed).
_notes.company: Legal entity is MyFunded Futures, LLC; terms are governed by Texas law (Collin County courts). Official pages state copyright '2023-2026' but do not state a founding date or HQ address, so founded/hq are omitted. Third-party sources say CEO Matthew Leech, Dallas TX, launched 2023 - not used.
_notes.other_products: MyFunded Perpetuals is a separate company (Funding Perpetuals Holdings, Inc.) and is not listed. Legacy Flex and older Builder plans are no longer sold.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official MyFundedFutures page (or not expressible as one number - see the notes above). Check the live plan pages before publishing.
_notes.company_check: Re-checked 2026-10-11: myfundedfutures.com homepage states no founding date or address (no /about page). founded/hq still null.
_notes.affiliate_program: help.myfundedfutures.com 'Becoming an Affiliate' (updated 23 Sep 2026; read 2026-10-20): commission on evaluation and reset fees from referrals via link or code; paid monthly on fees actually collected; $100 minimum payout. Open to any individual or company in the prop trading industry, explicitly including funded-account reviewers, blogs and forums (so comparison sites qualify). Only people from countries allowed to trade with MFFU can join. Commission % and cookie length not read. Apply: application in the MyFundedFutures dashboard (account needed).

firm.name: MyFundedFutures
firm.name_note: MyFundedFutures (myfundedfutures.com, 'MFFU'), operated by MyFunded Futures, LLC. Not the same as My Forex Funds or MyFundedFX.
firm.about: MyFundedFutures is a futures-only firm selling one-time-fee simulated evaluations from $25K to $150K across four plans (Builder, Rapid, Rapid EOD and Pro), with no activation fee after passing. Plans differ mainly in drawdown style, payout timing and profit split.

countries.notes: The United Arab Emirates is on MyFundedFutures' restricted list, as are several other Gulf and EU countries (Qatar, Jordan, Bulgaria, Croatia, Malta, Romania, Slovenia). The list also covers Crimea and, for France, only Corsica and the non-mainland islands (mainland France is not restricted, so FR is not listed). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). Traders visiting a restricted country can keep trading existing accounts but cannot buy or reset accounts while there. The terms also exclude anyone in a US-sanctioned (OFAC) jurisdiction and say restricted participants may only use simulated accounts with limited payouts.
